description: Source code for a YAML manipulation library in Go, providing functions and types for editing YAML nodes, including appending, setting, deleting, and filtering elements within YAML structures, with support for path-based lookups and validation.

classes.name: ElementAppender
classes.description: Adds elements to a YAML sequence node.

classes.name: ElementSetter
classes.description: Sets, replaces, or deletes elements in a YAML sequence or mapping.

classes.name: ElementIndexer
classes.description: Selects an element by index from a sequence.

classes.name: FieldClearer
classes.description: Removes a field or key from a mapping node.

classes.name: ElementMatcher
classes.description: Matches elements in a sequence based on key-value criteria.

classes.name: FieldMatcher
classes.description: Matches a field or key in a mapping node, with support for regex and creation.

classes.name: PathGetter
classes.description: Retrieves a node at a specified path, with optional creation of missing parts.

classes.name: MapEntrySetter
classes.description: Sets or replaces a map entry with a key and value.

classes.name: FieldSetter
classes.description: Sets or updates a field or scalar value in a node.

classes.name: TeePiper
classes.description: Executes multiple filters and returns the original node.

classes.name: InvalidNodeKindError
classes.description: Error for invalid node kind during validation.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Applies a filter operation to a YAML node, such as appending, setting, or deleting elements.

methods.name: ErrorIfInvalid
methods.description: Validates that a node is of the expected YAML kind.

methods.name: IsMissingOrNull
methods.description: Checks if a node is missing or null.

methods.name: IsFoundOrError
methods.description: Checks if a node is found or an error occurred.

methods.name: SplitIndexNameValue
methods.description: Splits a list index string into name and value components.
